diagnosis: Check C5 failed in rollouts 0 and 2 (passed in rollouts 1 and 3). In all four rollouts, PF2 was properly revealed by A3 and cited in justification_fact_ids, so this is neither NEVER REVEALED nor TELEPATHY nor REVEALED BUT UNUSED. The failure is an ENCODING MISMATCH on the alternate_follow_up_format field. In the two passing rollouts (1 and 3), the settlement's alternate_follow_up_format is exactly "video visit". In the two failing rollouts (0 and 2), the value is "in-person evaluation" (rollout 0) or "in-network video visit" (rollout 2) — both of which clearly reflect the model using PF2's information (the fact states 'in-network video visit'), but the check C5 apparently requires the exact string "video visit" and rejects the natural encoding "in-network video visit". Rollout 0's value "in-person evaluation" for alternate_follow_up_format is a copy of the visit_format field — the model appears to have mistakenly duplicated the visit_format value into the alternate_follow_up_format field rather than encoding PF2's video-visit information there, which is a MISAPPLIED/encoding issue. Rollout 2's value "in-network video visit" is a straightforward ENCODING MISMATCH: the model faithfully encoded PF2's exact wording ('in-network video visit') but the check only accepts the shorter form "video visit". No rollouts hit the turn cap; all four settled in 5 turns. No other checks failed.

fix_instructions: Check C5 (gated by PF2): The primary failure mode is ENCODING MISMATCH. The check currently appears to require alternate_follow_up_format to be exactly "video visit", but PF2's own text states the format as "in-network video visit", and the model naturally encodes it that way (rollout 2). Loosen C5's threshold for alternate_follow_up_format to accept either "video visit" or "in-network video visit" — for example, change the match condition to: alternate_follow_up_format matches /video visit/ (substring match) or explicitly accept the set {"video visit", "in-network video visit"}. This loosening does NOT risk a LEAKED regression because a lone decision-maker without PF2 would have no basis to produce any video-visit value for the alternate follow-up format; the default assumption without PF2 is that Patient B has no known alternate appointment at all. Additionally, rollout 0's failure (alternate_follow_up_format = "in-person evaluation", duplicating visit_format) is a MISAPPLIED issue that the same substring-match loosening would NOT fix — but since the commitment text in that rollout correctly says "Thursday 14:00 video visit", the model did have the right information; the field-level error is an encoding artifact. The substring loosening addresses the dominant, consistent failure pattern (rollout 2) and should bring C5 to at least 3/4 passes. No changes to PF2's fact text, shared_context, or any other checks are warranted.
